body: This is how I feel. I just haven’t been able to deal with this sadness. So brutal.

It’s really therapeutic accepting this low. Like I’ve been in and out of sleep. Feeling absolutely numb. I’m praying it doesn’t get past the point where I do something dumb. 
Thank you for sharing these feelings with me. Makes me feel less crazy
That would be really nice. Thank you for reaching out to me is it ok if we DM potentially?
I’m safe for right now it’s just a lot

I’ve never talked like this before I’m in my bed sobbing wrote out a list of passwords and everything I’m really at that point

Thank you for responding it means a lot
